outcome: mRNA expression of FABP3, 4, 5 and PPARgamma
cohort: Placental macrovascular endothelial cells and trophoblasts were isolated from lean (pregravid BMI <25 kg/m2) and obese (body mass index (BMI) > 30) women.
finding: In obese women, FA transporter expression is lower in placental endothelial cells, but not trophoblasts, and less sensitive to saturated FA, compared to lean women.
